records.subject: You're in -- let's get Willow Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. You've got your first project created, which is the main hurdle -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step is bringing in the people whose work lives there: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting your team's real work into Wrenfield with you.

Best,
Chidi
